messages:
anya: Heads up — nightly long-context eval (run id 2026-03-18_03) shows instruction echoing for redwood-neo-13b-q8. Starts ~2k tokens in, lots of prompts failing. anyone seen this?

eval-bot: nightly-eval: id=2026-03-18_03 model=redwood-neo-13b-q8 failures=21/360 drift=+0.12 (instr-echo metric). sample_ids: [42, 173, 221] — full logs uploaded to s3://redwood-nightly/2026-03-18_03/eval.log

simon: can you paste a minimal reproducer? does it happen with smaller context or only >2k?

anya: quick reproducer (python sdk):
```python
from redwood import Client
cli = Client(api_key=os.environ['RW_KEY'])
prompt = "<INSTRUCTION>\n" + "A"*2100 + "\n<END>"
res = cli.generate(model='redwood-neo-13b-q8', prompt=prompt, max_tokens=200, context_window=4096)
print(res.text)
```

results: the generated text repeats the instruction block ("<INSTRUCTION>...<END>") verbatim mid-output, sometimes multiple times.

josh: that smells like KV-cache slot reuse / wraparound. did we change the kv-slot size or seqnum logic in the q8 runtime last week?

marta: we did land the q8 kernel upgrade + a small change to prefix-eviction heuristics in commit c3f7a. nothing touched seqnum, but eviction code changed how we compute kv_slot_index = (seqnum + offset) % KV_SLOTS.

simon: interesting. can you grep the runtime logs for "kv_slot_index" around the request id? should show if slot indices reset.

anya: ran with INFER_DEBUG_KV=1 and pasted snippet:
```
[kv] req=abc123 seqnum=2049 kv_slot_index=1 prev_seq= -2047
[kv] put token_range=0..2048 -> slot=1
[kv] get hit slot=1 returned tokens matching prompt prefix
[gen] emitted instruction block from cached slot 1 at gen_pos=2070
```

josh: whoa prev_seq negative? looks like signed int overflow in seqnum arithmetic when context > 2048. that would cause old prefix to be considered current.

marta: that aligns — our KV_SLOTS constant is 2048 and some arithmetic assumed 32-bit signed wrap. the recent change added an offset subtraction but didn't udl/unsigned mask.

simon: can you reproduce in a unit test? e.g. simulate seqnum large value and check kv_slot_index monotonicity. if we can trigger locally, we can craft a tiny patch.

anya: I wrote a quick pytest that flips seqnum to 2**31-10 and repros the rotation. failing test attached in gist: https://gist.github.com/anya/kv-wrap-repro

josh: ok plan: (1) hotfix runtime to use unsigned 64-bit arithmetic for seqnum/slot math, (2) revert the eviction heuristic tweak if it relies on signed assumptions, (3) run a canary in staging with long-context harness.

marta: agree. i'll open a P0 ticket and assign to eng-runtime. also will add a defensive check: if kv_get returns a slot whose tokens match a very recent instruction (within last 128 tokens), treat as miss and avoid echo.

simon: also add an eval regression test to nightly that crafts a 4k context with an instruction near the rollover boundary. put it in long-context smoke so we catch future regressions.

anya: created issue RW-4532 with reproducer + logs. tagging @eng-runtime and @eng-ml. setting P1 -> P0 if we see >10% failure in production.

marta: assigning to josh for hotfix. i'll schedule a quick rollback of the q8 eviction tweak if patch isn't ready in 2h.

josh: working on patch now. will push PR and link here.

anya: thanks — will keep monitoring nightly. :thumbsup:
